risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (461), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational revenues, FOMC event in 2 days, and earnings in 51 days create compounded uncertainty.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + 15x volume spike + RSI extreme overbought creates textbook momentum reversal setup with defined support at 627.17 in fear-zone market environment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 84.22), zero crossover confirmations, weak trend strength (ADX 17.63), negative CMF, FOMC in 2 days, earnings in 51 days, and unfavorable macro (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, USD headwind) create compounded pullback/gap-down risk that outweighs momentum signals.
